name: Rakudo yo Ori e
source:
In a village deep in the mountains, Kizirushi Ren  is captured by a strange religious group and made into a "god."

A boy named Natsume Takumi was assigned to take care of his new life in a prison cell..

Until a few years ago, Takumi, who was on the throne of "God", began to treat Ren with a sense of hatred, but...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7333]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
在深山中的村庄里，Kizirushi Ren被一个奇怪的宗教团体抓走，并被奉为“神”。

一个名叫Natsume Takumi的少年被指派在牢房里照料Ren，陪他开始新的生活。

几年前，曾坐上“神”之位的Takumi开始对Ren怀有敌意……然而……
